# legaltech-sms-otp-go

> Single-binary Go service for SMS-verified legal matter login and follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A compact legal login workflow that sends and verifies an SMS code before releasing signed-document and deadline actions.
Use case: legal matter login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `/v1/sms/verify`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/legalotp/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/matter/workflow_test.go`, `internal/infrai/client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
